_doc: Bookkeeping for parked features (parked/README.md, task M1-08). stats: GameState.stats keys that only a parked feature writes. A planet's goal table may still hold goals that wait on one of them; the goal chain leaves those out (Goals.playable in story/goals.gd), so the tracker never shows a goal nobody can finish. When a feature comes back, take its stats off this list. When no planet table holds such goals any more, delete this file and the filter.
